tokens.name: twiligent-red
tokens.usage: The brand colour, sampled from the lit face of the mark. Primary actions, the mark, key highlights. White text on it (on-red) holds 5.9:1.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Mid fold of the ribbon. Hover/pressed for red fills on light, the middle stop of fold-gradient, secondary brand fields.

tokens.name: oxblood
tokens.usage: Deepest fold of the ribbon. Large dark brand fields, the end stop of fold-gradient. White text on it holds 12:1.

tokens.name: dusk
tokens.usage: Warm near-black. The dark brand ground (decks, app icon, social) and light-theme ink.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Warm off-white. Light brand ground and light-theme page background.

tokens.name: afterglow
tokens.usage: The one accent: the last light of dusk. Sparing highlights, data series two, badges. Never for text on light grounds; use afterglow-text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, code blocks, table stripes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders (decorative, not a control boundary).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; holds 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: dusk-panel
tokens.usage: Dark feature panels (Card tone dusk, slide frames). Lifted in the dark theme so it still reads as a panel. Text on it: #F5EFEB (15:1 / 13:1) and #C9BCC0.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, placeholders on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on ink-coloured fills (tooltips, inverse chips).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected state, the mark. Pair with on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed of accent fills. on-accent still holds 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Red links and emphasis as text, on surface, surface-raised and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind accent-text: selected rows, red badges.

tokens.name: afterglow-text
tokens.usage: Afterglow as text, on surface, surface-raised and afterglow-soft.

tokens.name: afterglow-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind afterglow-text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on surface and surface-raised; always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Behind success text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Behind info text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors share the brand red, so an error ALWAYS carries an icon and a word ("Error", "Failed"), never colour alone.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring, 2px offset in the surface colour. 3:1+ on every surface in both themes.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Sora SemiBold, tight tracking. The wordmark face. Headlines only, never paragraphs.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline, one per page; decks and social.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card and panel titles in product UI.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Twiligent turns scattered signals into one clear picture.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your workspace is ready. Invite the team when you are.
styles.usage: Default reading text in product and docs.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above headlines. Set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, CLI, IDs and numbers in tables.

spacing.note: 4px base; the larger steps roughly follow the ribbon thickness ratio.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows and form fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding, card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, gutters.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups within a section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top padding, slide margins.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on marketing pages.

radius.note: Capsules echo the rounded ribbon ends; containers stay softly squared.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small chips, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero media, large feature blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and badges: the capsule, like the ribbon ends.

shadow.note: Warm, low shadows tinted with dusk; deeper in dark.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, raised buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Cards on hover, menus.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and popovers.

gradient.note: The one gradient: the ribbon turning into shadow.

tokens.name: fold-gradient
tokens.usage: Hero bands and covers only. Never behind body text; never with other hues.
